LESSON: PRAYER CHURCH

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 5.1: Prayer Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Prayer Church. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How frequently do you God ● Learners to read Luke 11:5-10 recite The Lord’s prayer?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya
3. practise Prayer Church in clear steps
4. apply Prayer Church in one real-life situation this week

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PRAYER CHURCH
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Prayer Church helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PRAYER CHURCH
Study Prayer Church like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Prayer Church” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya

What this means
In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Prayer Church in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Prayer Church in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Prayer Church in clear steps. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: practise Prayer Church in clear steps.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Prayer Church in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Prayer Church in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Prayer Church in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Prayer Church in one real-life situation this week.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Prayer Church” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Prayer Church in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Prayer Church is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Prayer Church” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Prayer Church in your own words. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: practise Prayer Church in clear steps)

Example 4: Show how “Prayer Church” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply Prayer Church in one real-life situation this week)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Prayer Church to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Prayer Church in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Prayer Church from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Prayer Church: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Prayer Church?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How frequently do you God ● Learners to read Luke 11:5-10 recite The Lord’s prayer?
2. Why should we pray 44 and apply it in their lives midnight always?
3. What happened to a friend relationship with God of prayer who visited at midnight?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Prayer Church means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Prayer Church means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Prayer Church from Kenya.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
